archiveValidation.scope: SHA-256/SHA-512, sidecars, manifests, member sets, safe paths and every payload hash verified before extraction. Every relative import of the usage producer (main/enterprise/usage: usageReportFromStats, observeStats, usageSettlingSink), the content collection source, capture and CONTENT-LOCAL/1 delivery (main/enterprise/content) and the VIBES publisher (main/enterprise/vibes) was redirected to the compiled desktop archive, and every import of the lifecycle projector, event journal and usage provenance tracker (shared/maestro-lib/managed/events, managed/event-journal, streaming/usage-accumulator) to the public runtime bundle; four suites (usage, content, vibes, telemetry incl. the usage family through the journal and client) ran on those bytes. Service, enterprise IPC and conformance suites stay source-only. Public declaration checks and a plain Node load of both archives (a filled-in zero never reported as a figure, a context replay a correction, metadata-only admits no role, VIBES only under full_vibes, an unknown ceiling key refuses the document, text is not a fact field, no injected port means no delivery, unobserved results are named gaps) passed. Temporary identity-only pin leaves the historical runtime pin unchanged.

tests.boundary: Local typed-port and public-schema fixtures, a CONTENT-LOCAL/1 port double, temporary data directories and recording sinks only. No signed production delivery, real tenant, provider, native peer or live endpoint supplied authority.

behavior: Real process usage (the process manager usage event) streams into the managed usage producer; each terminal lifecycle fact of a non-shell run settles that run under its own provider, model, lineage and admission; a silent run is unavailable, never a zero; a replay adds only missingness; idempotency is the usage event id.
Desktop inventory reports the tracked usage count instead of null.

The content ceiling is read through an injected CONTENT-LOCAL/1 port only for the applied revision and profile; rollback, same-revision rewrite, a changed standing mid-read and malformed documents are refused and the previous ceiling kept.

Held content uploads oldest first in bounded passes of digest-named chunks; a record is uploaded only on an acceptance echoing the exact digest and length, a lost answer is resolved by status before any resend, a final denial releases the bytes, revoke asks the endpoint to delete what it accepted. Without a port (the production default) records stay pending_upload.

Each finished root run tree publishes its recorded VIBES graph through the same content capture (full_vibes and a granting ceiling only), naming trigger and source event ids, origins, revisions and digest, with unobserved tool and subagent results as named gaps.

contractMappings.remaining: No published endpoint operation carries content; delivery implements the already-recorded CONTENT-LOCAL/1 proposal behind an injected port and is not advertised. Usage and VIBES metadata travel the existing event journal and telemetry client. contract-coverage.json gained no entry in this phase. Production delivery still requires authenticated negotiated authority (CP-01).
